cap: Each antiretroviral drug carries one signature price. Abacavir causes hypersensitivity in HLA-B*57:01 carriers, the older NRTIs stavudine and didanosine inhibit mitochondrial polymerase gamma and cause lactic acidosis, and low-dose ritonavir works by inhibiting CYP3A4. The same drugs prevent infection: tenofovir with emtricitabine as PrEP, a three-drug course as PEP, and zidovudine with a scheduled cesarean when the viral load is high at delivery.
